result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered. One notable defect: the bottom navigation highlights the 'Profile' tab as active even though the Home screen content is being displayed, indicating an incorrect active-state indicator.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows 'Profile' as the active/selected tab (green icon and label) while the screen clearly displays the Home feed (delivery address, search, promo banner, restaurant carousels). The 'Home' tab is rendered in the inactive grey state. The active tab indicator does not match the current screen.
issues.suggestion: Bind the tab bar's active state to the current route so that the 'Home' tab is highlighted when the Home feed is shown, and 'Profile' is only highlighted when the profile screen is displayed.
